    66→// checkConcurrentSessions checks for concurrent session conflicts and shows warnings if needed.
    67→// Returns true if the hook should be skipped due to an unresolved conflict.
    68→func checkConcurrentSessions(ag agent.Agent, sessionID string) error {
    69→	repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository()
    70→	if err != nil {
    71→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to open git repository: %w", err)
    72→	}
    73→	strat := GetStrategy()
    74→
    75→	concurrentChecker, ok := strat.(strategy.ConcurrentSessionChecker)
    76→	if !ok {
    77→		return nil // Strategy doesn't support concurrent checks
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// Check for other active sessions with checkpoints (on current HEAD)
    81→	existingSessionState, checkErr := concurrentChecker.HasOtherActiveSessionsWithCheckpoints(sessionID)
    82→	hasConflict := checkErr == nil && existingSessionState != nil
    83→
    84→	if hasConflict {
    85→		shadowBranch := checkpoint.ShadowBranchNameForCommit(existingSessionState.BaseCommit, existingSessionState.WorktreeID)
    86→		refName := plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(shadowBranch)
    87→		_, err := repo.Reference(refName, true)
    88→		hasShadowBranch := err == nil
    89→		// Try to get the conflicting session's agent type from its state file
    90→		// If it's a different agent type, use that agent's resume command format
    91→		var resumeCmd string
    92→		if existingSessionState != nil && existingSessionState.AgentType != "" {
    93→			if conflictingAgent, agentErr := agent.GetByAgentType(existingSessionState.AgentType); agentErr == nil {
    94→				resumeCmd = conflictingAgent.FormatResumeCommand(existingSessionState.SessionID)
    95→			}
    96→		}
    97→		// Fall back to current agent if we couldn't get the conflicting agent
    98→		if resumeCmd == "" {
    99→			resumeCmd = ag.FormatResumeCommand(existingSessionState.SessionID)
   100→		}
   101→
   102→		message := fmt.Sprintf(
   103→			"Warning: Session ID conflict detected!\n\n"+
   104→				"Shadow branch: %s\n"+
   105→				"Existing session: %s\n"+
   106→				"New session: %s\n\n"+
   107→				"The shadow branch already has checkpoints from a different session.\n"+
   108→				"Starting a new session would orphan the existing work.\n\n"+
   109→				"Options:\n"+
   110→				"1. Commit your changes (git commit) to create a new base commit\n"+
   111→				"2. Run 'entire rewind reset' to discard the shadow branch and start fresh\n"+
   112→				"3. Resume the existing session: %s\n\n"+
   113→				"To suppress this warning in future sessions, run:\n"+

   115→			shadowBranch,
   116→			existingSessionState.SessionID,
   117→			sessionID,
   118→			resumeCmd,
   119→		)
   120→		// Output blocking JSON response - user must resolve conflict before continuing
   121→		if err := outputHookResponse(message); err != nil {
   122→			return err
   123→		}
   124→	}
   125→
   126→	return nil
   127→}
